defs.def: the quality of being pleasing to the senses or to the mind 美；美丽

ex.s: They provide shade, lower surface temperatures, absorb a surprising amount of airborne carbon, remove tiny pollutants, and provide wildlife habitat along with just plain beauty.
ex.t: 它们提供树荫、降低地表温度、吸收可观的空气中的碳、清除微小污染物，并提供野生动物栖息地，还有纯粹的美的享受。

ex.s: Participants were randomly divided into two groups: the “beauty” group was asked to actively consider and then rate the beauty of each object they viewed, while the control group just matched a line drawing of the object with the artwork itself.
ex.t: 参与者被随机分为两组：“美”组被要求主动思考并为所看到的每件物品的美打分，而对照组只是将物品的线描图与艺术品本身进行匹配。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group scored almost 14% higher on average than the control group in abstract thinking.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，美组在抽象思维上平均比控制组高出近14%。

ex.s: Across all participants, those in the beauty group reported an average of 23% higher levels of “transformative and self-transcendent feelings” — such as feeling moved, enlightened and inspired — than the control group.
ex.t: 在所有参与者中，“美”组报告的“蜕变与超越自我的感受”——如感动、顿悟和受启发——平均比对照组高出23%。

ex.s: Admiring the beauty of art may be the ideal way to initiate the abstract cognitive processes.”
ex.t: 欣赏艺术之美或许是开启抽象认知过程的理想方式。”

ex.s: What was the beauty group asked to do with the clay objects?
ex.t: 美感组被要求对这些陶艺品做什么？

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: To reveal the beauty of science in an artistic way.
ex.t: 为了以艺术的方式揭示科学之美。

ex.s: The natural beauty of the West
ex.t: 西部的自然之美。

ex.s: Why does the author mention “beauty” in Paragraph 2?
ex.t: 作者在第2段提到"美"是为了什么？

ex.s: Fascinated by the structural beauty of the Forbidden City as a painter, she is equally interested to learn more about Chinese philosophy.
ex.t: 作为一名画家，她为紫禁城的结构之美所吸引，同样也有兴趣更多地了解中国哲学。

ex.s: He learned the value and beauty of    22    there from a very young age.
ex.t: 他从小就在那里懂得了___22___的价值与美。

ex.s: To reveal the beauty of ancient objects.
ex.t: 揭示古代物品之美。

ex.s: The   42   might damage the beauty of the place.
ex.t: ____42____ 可能会破坏该地的美感。

ex.s: The natural beauty isn't attractive to them．
ex.t: A．自然之美对他们没有吸引力。

ex.s: And while many Brits like nothing better than spending their Sunday cutting the grass, some are happy just to sit under the branches of the trees and enjoy the beauty of the world around them.
ex.t: 虽然许多英国人最喜欢的事情莫过于在周日修剪草坪，但有些人也乐于坐在树枝下，享受周围世界的美丽。

ex.s: Because I thought ballet was more or less the same everywhere, I was totally unprepared for its unique beauty.
ex.t: 因为我原以为芭蕾舞无论在哪里都大同小异，所以对它独特的美毫无准备。

ex.s: Now we have another chance to look up at the starts of New Orleans, their beauty inspiring us and giving us confidence to move on.
ex.t: 现在我们又有机会仰望新奥尔良的星空，它们的美丽激励着我们，给我们继续前行的信心。

ex.s: If I can get so much pleasure from touch, how much more beauty must be revealed by sight?
ex.t: 如果我能从触觉中获得如此多的快乐，那么视觉必定能揭示出多少更多的美啊？

ex.s: Importantly, however, the beauty group did not report feeling any happier than the control group, suggesting that it was the engagement with beauty that influenced abstract thinking, rather than any overall positivity from the experience.
ex.t: 然而重要的是，美感组并没有报告比对照组更快乐，这表明影响抽象思维的是与美的接触，而不是这次经历带来的整体积极情绪。

ex.s: But Sarah,  64  has taken part in shows along with top models, wants 65      (prove) that she has brains as well as beauty.
ex.t: 但曾与顶级模特同台演出的萨拉，想____65____（prove）她既有美貌也有智慧。

ex.s: More and more people feel that by using natural dyes, we can remind ourselves of nature's beauty and protect the natural world.
ex.t: 越来越多的人感到，通过使用天然染料，我们可以提醒自己大自然的美，并保护自然世界。

ex.s: The concept of beauty today is very different from what it was in ancient Greece or the Middle Ages, and so are most of our “laws” of nature.
ex.t: 如今美的概念与古希腊或中世纪时的概念大不相同，我们大多数自然"定律"也是如此。

ex.s: People tend to be blind to the beauty around them．
ex.t: C. 人们往往对他们周围的美视而不见。

ex.s: Many visitors support the Florida’s coast recovery for its beauty.
ex.t: 许多游客支持佛罗里达海岸因其美丽而恢复。

defs.def: a person or thing that is beautiful 美人；美好的东西

ex.s: Beauty group, with an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 美感组中有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Beauty group, without an artistic hobby.
ex.t: 美感组中没有艺术爱好的人。

ex.s: Among those, the effect was greater: those with an artistic hobby in the beauty group scored over 25% higher on average for abstract thinking than those with an artistic hobby in the control group.
ex.t: 在其中，效果更明显：有艺术爱好的“美”组在抽象思维上的平均得分比有艺术爱好的对照组高出25%以上。

ex.s: The beauty of rereading lies in the idea that our bond with the work is based on our present mental register.
ex.t: 是真的，年纪越大，我越觉得时光飞逝。
